population: national and international weightlifting meets (OpenWeightlifting), best result per lifter
how_to_use: lifts[lift][i][j] is the lift (kg) at percentiles[j] for bodyweight bodyweights_kg[i]. Your percentile = interpolate your lift between the two columns it falls between, in the row for your bodyweight. Below the first column: under 1st percentile; above the last: over 99.9th.
